text: 基础设施建设投资先行指标回暖，多地加快部署推进“六张网”建设，超长期特别国债等资金加速落地……一系列信号显示，投资企稳势能正在积蓄。分析人士认为，下半年，随着稳投资政策落地，基建投资有望企稳回升，并对整体投资形成支撑。
text_en: Infrastructure investment leading indicators are recovering. Multiple regions accelerate 'six networks' construction planning, ultra-long special treasury bonds are speeding up... These signals suggest investment stabilizing momentum is building. Analysts believe with policy implementation, infrastructure investment may stabilize and rise in H2, supporting overall investment.
